provenance.notes: Zone C drop (R5-03.S3): the two 24x15 walk frames of the HUSK CRAWLER beetle walker are the first two cells (reading order) of the owner-picked animation sheet — the sheet's own order claims four walk-cycle cells then the exposed-core and destroyed states, and the probe agrees: the first four cells are one carapace silhouette with 5 % leg-only pixel differences while the last two are 248 and 251 px tall (the flipped shell, the cracked wreck); walk cycle frames 1 and 2 land in the slot, frames 3 and 4 stay unused until an animation rework names them, and the weak-point and destroyed cells are hit-state art. Cropped from the committed winner with a 6-px key border; the crop rings were probed to zero foreign pixels. The design carries its own 1-px near-black navy outline, so the outline pass is off.
